entities.summary: Bernd Wittenburg is an East German former middleweight boxer who competed at the 1976 Montreal Olympics and who won titles for the SC Dynamo Berlin / Sportvereinigung (SV) Dynamo. He won the GDR Championships in boxing in 1972, 1973, 1974, 1975 and 1976.
